title: A galactic neighborhood
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: A galaxy group contains multiple galaxies in a shared gravitational environment. The Milky Way and Andromeda belong to the Local Group.

misconception: A learner may choose: A group of planets around a single star
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What is a galaxy group?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What is a galaxy group? A collection of galaxies associated by gravity. A galaxy group contains multiple galaxies in a shared gravitational environment. The Milky Way and Andromeda belong to the Local Group.
Visual caption: Many galaxies in a group. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: What is a galaxy group?
options: A group of planets around a single star
A single star and its moons
A collection of galaxies associated by gravity
recall.why: A galaxy group contains multiple galaxies in a shared gravitational environment. The Milky Way and Andromeda belong to the Local Group.
